description:
DataGlass helps marketplace sellers understand profitability and identify opportunities to improve business performance.

Connect your Shopee, Lazada, or TikTok Shop account to analyze sales, advertising performance, fees, costs, margins, and operational metrics. Ask questions about your business in natural language and receive data-backed insights based on your shop’s actual data.

Use DataGlass to:
• Analyze product and campaign profitability
• Understand true ROAS after fees and costs
• Identify underperforming products and ads
• Find opportunities to improve margins
• Compare performance across products and campaigns
• Explore recommendations for pricing, advertising, and inventory decisions

DataGlass combines analytics and optimization techniques to help sellers make more informed decisions using their marketplace data.
